title: Native reference replay inputs and comparisons
description: Closed software-fixture inputs. Dynamic key, source, clock, reference, and exact-result checks remain native owner obligations. No hosted, human, legal, FNS, or publication qualification.

beforeEventIndex.description: Zero-based index of the fixture event before which the native replay clock advances.

duration.description: Positive ISO 8601 duration in whole days added to the native replay clock before that event.

firingOccurrence.description: Zero-based occurrence of an actual saved determining firing for the named binding.

kidBase64.description: Base64-encoded key identifier used to select the trusted fixture receipt signer.

publicKeyBase64.description: Base64-encoded raw Ed25519 public key used to verify the fixture receipt signature.

attempt.description: One-based transport attempt number at which the fixture injects its configured failure.

pkcs8Base64.description: Base64-encoded PKCS #8 Ed25519 private key for synthetic fixture document signing; a local software capability, never a production key.

receiptPkcs8Base64.description: Base64-encoded PKCS #8 Ed25519 private key for synthetic fixture receipt signing; a local software capability, never a production key.

kidBase64.description: Base64-encoded key identifier that must match the protected document-signing key ID.

publicKeyBase64.description: Base64-encoded raw Ed25519 public key for the selected fixture document signer.

bytesBase64.description: Base64 representation of the exact retained evidence bytes checked against the selected digest.

maxInvocations.description: Maximum number of actual calls the fixture permits for this service selection.

documentRef.description: Reference to the OpenAPI document that describes the operation selected for replay.

operationRef.description: Named OpenAPI operation within the selected document for this fixture invocation.

endpoint.description: Endpoint identity for the Open Policy Agent invocation selected by the fixture.

additionalProperties.description: Formspec Expression Language (FEL) expression used to compute this named invocation input value.

inputMapping.description: Named request fields and their Formspec Expression Language (FEL) expressions for the fixture invocation.

additionalProperties.description: Response selector that supplies the value written to the named workflow destination.

outputBinding.description: Workflow destinations and the corresponding response selectors for the actual fixture invocation output.

id.description: Authored identifier of a section within the selected fixture notification template.

anyOf.description: Authored heading that labels the section in the rendered fixture notice.
The authored fixture notice section explicitly supplies no displayed heading.
Authored section body text, optionally containing placeholders for rendered variables.
The authored template section explicitly supplies no body text for rendering.

required.description: Whether the section must supply body content for native notice rendering to succeed.

anyOf.description: Authored section visibility expression. Native replay refuses a selected notice template with a conditional section.
The authored template section explicitly supplies no visibility condition.
Human-readable description of the purpose of this fixture notice template.
examples: Notice that a completed review changed the case status.

anyOf.description: The selected fixture notice template explicitly supplies no description text.
Authored subject line for the fixture notice, optionally including variable placeholders.
The selected fixture notice template explicitly supplies no authored subject line.

items.description: Name of a variable that the rendering context must supply for this notice template.

anyOf.description: Locale tag that must match the required variant when replay selects this notice template.
The selected fixture notice template explicitly supplies no locale-specific variant reference.
Regulatory or statutory authority requiring this notification, as authored in the fixture template.
The selected fixture notice template explicitly supplies no authority reference.

extensions.description: Empty extension map because the native replay template adapter supports no extension keys.

anyOf.description: Optional schema URI declared by this fixture adapter's notification template document.
The fixture notification template document explicitly supplies no schema URI.

targetWorkflow.description: Canonical workflow URL that this fixture notification template document declares as its target.

anyOf.description: Version identifying the fixture notification template document selected for replay.
The fixture notification template document explicitly supplies no version value.
Human-readable title of the notification template document used for native replay.
The fixture notification template document explicitly supplies no human-readable title.
Human-readable description of the fixture notification template document's purpose.
examples: Templates used by replay of the fixture review workflow.

anyOf.description: The fixture notification template document explicitly supplies no description text.

templates.description: Map from the authored template keys used by the workflow to the fixture notice templates.

extensions.description: Empty extension map because replay supports no extension keys at the template document level.

NotificationTemplateDocument.description: Maintained native NotificationTemplateDocument adapter DTO; not a complete canonical Delivery document.

calendarDaysFromFiling.description: Whole UTC calendar days the recipe adds to the native appeal filing time to schedule a hearing.

rationale.description: Reason the recipe supplies to explain the reviewer's proposed appeal disposition.
examples: The hearing record established that the household met the limit.

rationale.description: Reason the recipe supplies for the household's request to end continued service.
examples: The household submitted a signed request to end continued service.

rationale.description: Reason the recipe supplies for extending the time before issuing the notice.
examples: Additional time is needed to verify the newly submitted evidence.

signatureId.description: Authored signature identity carried into the actual Formspec signature record.

documentId.description: Identity of the signing document declared in the selected Signature Profile.

signingIntent.description: Authored signature intent that must agree with the intent for the selected signing step.

documentHash.description: Authored document digest that must agree with the selected Signature Profile document.

documentHashAlgorithm.description: Digest algorithm named in the selected Signature Profile for the authored document hash.

signatureProvider.description: Identity of the selected signature provider recorded with the authored metadata.

ceremonyId.description: Identity of the fixture ceremony associated with the authored signature metadata.

signerId.description: Canonical human actor identity that must agree with the fixture task's signer.

signerName.description: Display name supplied for the signer in the authored fixture ceremony metadata.

consentTextRef.description: Reference to the exact authored consent text accepted for this fixture signature.

consentVersion.description: Version of the consent text identified by the authored consent reference.

affirmationText.description: Exact authored statement that the signer affirmed in the selected fixture ceremony.

eventIndex.description: Zero-based position of the original event associated with the actual native attempt.

occurrence.description: Zero-based occurrence of the attempt within the selected event index and attempt kind.

firingOccurrence.description: Zero-based occurrence of a saved determining firing under the selected binding.

evaluationOccurrence.description: Zero-based occurrence of the evaluation for the selected transition, whether it fired or not.

operationOccurrence.description: Zero-based occurrence of the actual governed operation for the selected operation reference.

taskOccurrence.description: Zero-based occurrence of an actual native task under the selected task reference.

timerId.description: Identity of the native timer as recorded in the saved execution's timer history.

timerOccurrence.description: Zero-based occurrence of a recorded timer lifetime with the selected timer identity.

operationOccurrence.description: Zero-based occurrence of the actual governed operation associated with the retained override.

determinationId.description: Identity of the saved determination whose actual notice and delivery evidence are selected.
Identity of the saved determination whose actual appeal and hearing state are selected.

url.description: Canonical URL of the exact Formspec Definition paired with this selected Mapping dependency, chosen independently of the Mapping's version range.

version.description: Exact version of the Formspec Definition paired with the selected Mapping, pinned beside its canonical URL.

role.description: Role that identifies how native replay should interpret the selected dependency's original bytes.

url.description: Canonical URL identifying the resolved dependency whose original bytes accompany the request.

anyOf.description: Version pin for the resolved dependency when it has a separately selected version.
The selected replay dependency explicitly supplies no version pin in its descriptor.

items.description: One unsigned byte in the exact original document bytes supplied for this dependency.
One unsigned byte from the exact candidate workflow document in its original order.

fixtureJson.description: Serialized JSON text of the selected fixture input, including its original event sequence.

clockStartMs.description: Initial native replay clock expressed in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

items.description: Name of a supported native observation category this run requests; unsupported names refuse, and the list binds into replay identity.

thresholdPercentagePoints.description: Exclusive upper bound in percentage points on the absolute approval-rate difference between paired groups.
Reviewed exclusive upper bound on the absolute approval-rate difference in percentage points.

id.description: Identity of the model reviewer responsible for the fixture engineering review.

method.description: Review method used by the named model to examine the retained fixture evidence.
examples: Compared the exact rendered text and the date shown in each variant.

rationale.description: Concrete basis for the engineering review decision on this exact metric descriptor.
examples: Reviewed each matched pair and verified the strict five-point threshold against the fixture source.

observations.description: Concrete observations explaining the verdict for one engineering review claim.
examples: Both language variants show the same appeal deadline.

locale.description: Exact locale tag used to associate a reviewed body digest with a rendered notice variant.

observations.description: Claim-keyed verdicts and concrete observations for the exact retained notice reviewed.

plainLanguageEngineeringReview.observations: The next action is stated in the opening paragraph.

items.description: One concrete boundary on what the engineering fixture review establishes.
examples: The review covers the retained fixture text and makes no accessibility compliance claim.

items.description: One unsigned byte from the original selected review document in its retained order.

comparisonClockMs.description: Admitted comparison time in Unix epoch milliseconds used to bound the retained review time.

JSONScalar.description: Exact string, Boolean or numeric case value used to distinguish paired comparison members.
